items.title: ScamAgent- AI Agent Built by Researchers that Run Fully Autonomous Scam Calls
items.description: ScamAgent is an autonomous, multi-turn AI framework developed by researcher Sanket Badhe at Rutgers University that demonstrates how large language models (LLMs) can be weaponized to conduct fully automated scam calls.
